name: Digging Through the Dirt
summary: You search for the Embalmer’s missing heart in Duskwood at Raven Hill Cemetery. A mound marked Eliza hides a buried horror that will not stay dead.

sections.title: A Grave Disturbed
sections.body: At Raven Hill Cemetery, a patch of loose, freshly turned soil bears the name Eliza. Other graves in Duskwood lie open to scavengers or feral ghouls, but someone placed this earth with care. Digging below the topsoil uncovers the splintered boards of a coffin. It seals away the remnant the Embalmer meant to hide from the light of day.

sections.title: The Scratching Within
sections.body: Eliza lies beneath the splintered coffin boards, but she is no resting corpse. The lid shudders with the scrape of clawed fingers and the clatter of rotting jaws. Abercrombie’s experiment stirs inside her pine coffin. The Embalmer’s missing heart beats in her breast as she waits for unwary hands to open the grave.

faq.q: What is buried in Eliza's grave?
faq.answer: A coffin lies beneath the dirt, holding Eliza, an undead creature made by the Embalmer. His heart rests in her breast.
Eliza’s grave lies in Raven Hill Cemetery in western Duskwood, among haunted crypts and roaming undead.

faq.q: Why do you have to dig into the coffin?
faq.answer: You dig into the grave to face Eliza and recover the Embalmer’s heart, ending the search for his foul schemes.

faq.q: What happens when the coffin is opened?
faq.answer: When you open the coffin, Eliza breaks free. You must destroy the clawing ghoul to recover the heart sealed inside with her.

faq.q: Who put Eliza in the ground?
faq.answer: The Embalmer buried Eliza in Raven Hill Cemetery, hiding his creation and prized heart among its graves.

aliases: what kind of monster is eliza
faq.answer: Eliza was the Embalmer’s wife, raised by his dark magic with his heart in her breast. She is tougher and more deliberate than the mindless ghouls roaming Duskwood’s roads.

angles.text: Disturbing a fresh grave violates the funeral rites of the Holy Light. Releasing and destroying the unnatural fiend within is an act of cleansing.
Scratching claws and gnashing teeth beneath consecrated soil offend the peaceful rest the Light promises Duskwood’s dead.
The Night Watch struggles against the terror spilling from Raven Hill. Finding the horrors buried by the Embalmer is vital to Darkshire’s safety.
